experiment.title: LSEG-33 prompt-engineered economic-value experiment
experiment.objective: Test whether target-specific return, cash-flow-revision, surprise-catalyst or red-team prompt wording improves later net economic value relative to the existing generic Gemma and FinBERT scores.
experiment.evidence_role: user-authorised iterative retrospective prompt search with a fixed chronological selection/test boundary

authorisation_and_spend.researcher_instruction: Use the available OpenRouter credit to try prompt engineering on the scoring and test whether economic value improves.
authorisation_and_spend.external_payload: selected Reuters headline, named target company and at most five strictly earlier same-company Reuters headlines
authorisation_and_spend.route: OpenRouter to DeepInfra only; Gemma 4 26B FP8; no fallback; ZDR requested; provider data collection denied
authorisation_and_spend.authoritative_cost: sum of reported_cost_usd over append-only prompt attempt rows
authorisation_and_spend.stop_rule: No request family may start if a one-character-per-token conservative estimate plus recorded experiment cost exceeds 19 dollars.

population.universe: same 33 LSEG companies; Reuters NS:RTRS only
population.filters: explicit target, non-market-price/technical, one original-33 company, first story-family release
population.spacing: one deterministic headline per company and first executable XNYS session
population.entry_timing: first XNYS open at least 15 minutes after availability
population.context: at most five strictly earlier same-company Reuters headlines in the frozen 30-day window, used only for newness

signal_translation.trade_signal: signed_probability times materiality weight when target_specific and new_information are both true; otherwise zero
signal_translation.portfolio: one strongest positive and one strongest negative company per formation session, plus 0.5 and minus 0.5, overlapping equal tranches for the prompt's fixed horizon

chronology.test_boundary: 2025 prompt outcomes are opened only if at least one prompt passes the fixed 2024 selection gate.

eligibility: 2024 net mean after 10 bps per side is positive
2024 break-even cost is at least 10 bps per side
net mean is positive in at least three of four non-overlapping 2024 quarters
net mean beats the exact same-date existing Gemma comparator in at least three of four 2024 quarters
selection.score: minimum quarterly net-mean difference versus the same-date existing Gemma comparator
tie_breakers: higher mean quarterly difference versus same-date Gemma
selection.no_eligible_candidate_action: stop without opening any 2025 prompt strategy result

comparators: existing generic Gemma polarity on the selected prompt's exact formation dates
existing FinBERT polarity on the selected prompt's exact formation dates
primary_family: selected prompt net mean versus cash
selected prompt minus same-date Gemma net mean
selected prompt minus same-date FinBERT net mean
test.inference: paired circular moving-block bootstrap with 10-session blocks and 9999 replications
test.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across the three primary tests at q=0.05
economic_gate: all three primary effects positive with BH q below 0.05
2025 break-even cost at least 10 bps per side
net mean positive in both 2025 halves

claim_boundaries: This is an iterative, retrospective prompt search on already-opened 2024-2025 LSEG outcomes, not independent confirmation.
The source regimes remain separate from FNSPID and 2026 remains sealed.
A positive result must beat same-date existing scorers after costs; gross loss avoidance or lower activity alone is not prompt information value.
No prompt wording, signal weight, horizon, cost, threshold, universe or portfolio rule may be changed after the new prompt scores are opened.
